build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a V-shaped cradle with a dynamic ball and target bar
create_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable scale, angle, and position using C.add
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned in a cradle using C.add with center_x and bottom
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the target bar using C.update_task
compute_sine_degrees: compute the sine of an angle given in degrees using the sin helper function
